Record Class ResourceSimulationCoupler.CouplingParameters

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
org.ether.society.ui.resource.ResourceSimulationCoupler.CouplingParameters
Record Components:
totalBiomass - terrestrial biomass in GtC
totalSoilCarbon - soil organic carbon in GtC
totalFaunaBiomass - faunal livestock biomass in GtC
totalAquaticBiomass - marine pelagic biomass in GtC
totalMetals - industrial metal reserves in Gt
totalPrecious - precious metals & REE in Mt
heatFlow - mantle heat flux in mW/m²
totalAquifer - freshwater aquifer volume in km³
planet - active planet preset
customBiomeImage - optional imported biome discrete polychrome map
customResourceImage - optional imported multi-channel resource map
Enclosing class:
ResourceSimulationCoupler
public static record ResourceSimulationCoupler.CouplingParameters(double totalBiomass, double totalSoilCarbon, double totalFaunaBiomass, double totalAquaticBiomass, double totalMetals, double totalPrecious, double heatFlow, double totalAquifer, PlanetPreset planet, javafx.scene.image.Image customBiomeImage, javafx.scene.image.Image customResourceImage) extends Record
Parameters bundle for coupling planetary ecological and geological tensors to cells.

    • equals

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. Reference components are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object); primitive components are compared with the compare method from their corresponding wrapper classes.
      Specified by:
      equals in class Record
      Parameters:
      o - the object with which to compare
      Returns:
      true if this object is the same as the o argument; false otherwise.
